sources.title: microduckapp/microduck-midnight-snack · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Midnight Snack Wanders over for a sleepy snack, pecks at the floor slower and slower — and nods off mid-peck. A 10.7-second move for the Microduck robot, from the MicroDuck app.
